title: Vercel’s Annualized Revenue Hits $600 Million Driven by AI Agents
summary:
Approximately 50% of new business for Vercel now stems from autonomous coding tools, a surge from the less than 3% recorded in January. The company’s annualized revenue has reached $600 million, representing 148% growth over the previous year, as the integration of AI agents became a primary driver for customer acquisition.

Vercel and database provider Supabase have emerged as the preferred infrastructure choices for developers building AI agents. This transition toward the agentic AI ecosystem has allowed Vercel to expand its market share among automated software engineering tools.
